title: S-M5 Action Stripe TC-1

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Built for aggressive dirt performance, the Alpinestars S-M5 Action Stripe TC-1 is purpose-built for off-road riders demanding massive aerobic cooling and roost deflection across punishing tracks and trails. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at 1423g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~98 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.06 impact standards. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Mid-tier MX with composite shell and multi-density EPS liner.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for dirt/MX riding; features action stripe detailing and TC-1 specific construction. Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shape.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Alpinestars S-M5 Action Stripe TC-1: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Alpinestars's Dirt / MX lineup, the S-M5 Action Stripe TC-1 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Alpinestars S-M5 Action Stripe TC-1 represents Alpinestars's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~98 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Alpinestars S-M5 Action Stripe TC-1 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
